reply: QUERY: SELECT s.cds, s.sname, CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / s.NumTstTakr as excellence_rate, CAST(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" AS FLOAT) / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" as free_rate FROM satscores s JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode WHERE CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3 AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0 ORDER BY free_rate DESC LIMIT 5
